name: Xining
registryBasis: The Xining Real Estate Registration Bureau operates an official local registration portal, xnsbdc.cn, with registration, certificate, archive-verification and transaction services. This confirms a city-local property registry; no public anonymous parcel geometry service was identified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Direct anonymous GETs confirm the public Xining registration portal loads, but its homepage and service-guide index contain no publicly advertised cadastral-map/vector route. The business-handling service path returns HTTP 302 to `/userlogin`. No anonymous full parcel geometry endpoint was found; no sign-in or property-specific query was attempted.
scopeLimits: The official Xining Real Estate Registration Bureau portal and service-guide index were directly fetched anonymously (HTTP 200) and their public HTML was inspected for map/cadastral terms and static script references. Neither index advertises a map layer; the business-handling path redirects to `/userlogin`. A service guide page loads as HTML but exposes only its title and a linked image; that image was not fetched. No anonymous machine-readable parcel geometry was obtained.
remainingUncertainty: A local map may exist behind the logged-in registration workflow or a separate Qinghai/Xining spatial service. The public portal’s HTML does not expose a map route; scripts related to authentication were not inspected and no login or personal data were used.
